replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body: On many maps, it could really hurt the gameplay if you were able to purchase any type of block.
replies.body_tagged: On many maps, it could really hurt the gameplay if you were able to purchase any type of block.

replies.author: Tempus
replies.body:
Yes, be that as it may, if the map creators implemented a hight / width limit, the purchasing of blocks may help.
The server's file usually have the YML, so that could be easily implemented.

replies.author: TheOpAmerican
replies.body:
What about just wood and glass ? Imo stone is OP because tunnelers.

Dare I bring up OCN, but they have a width limit on how far you can build on Project Ares maps, and we already have a height limit (don't we?) So it is possible to do it, IF that is in fact the concern that deters from adding blocks to the nub shop. I would really like to see this added because I see people building more intricate structures with it for defense and things like that. I think it might enhance the gameplay a bit. But, I don't know, that's just me.
